source.source_name: National Treasury eTenders — OCDS procurement API

transport.rate_limit: no key; requires dateFrom & dateTo query params

parsing.notes: OCDS release package; iterate releases[]. Required query params dateFrom & dateTo (e.g. yyyy-mm-dd) plus PageNumber/PageSize. Extract awards[].suppliers[].name + value (ZAR) + buyer.name + tender.title; filter parties by roles contains 'supplier'. Supplier identity is the legalName only (no CIPC registration number) — dedupe/join by normalised name. Some supplier names may be sole proprietors (POPIA).

mapping_rules.company_id: null — no registration number; key on normalised name.
mapping_rules.join: name-based to CIPC (no shared id in OCDS).

fixture_requirements: award release with supplier + ZAR value
compiled release with multiple parties (supplier + buyer)
supplier name that looks like a sole proprietor (POPIA handling)

live_test_plan.full: Page the date range; collect supplier names + procurement aggregates; dedupe by normalised name. No key.
